item.title: Northeastern flavours shine at this Hyderabad hotel's food weekend pop-up
item.description: The Westin Hyderabad Mindspace is hosting a Food Weekend Pop-Up until January 18, 2026, showcasing the vibrant and diverse cuisine of Northeast India. Curated by renowned home-chef Gitika Saikia, the event features a variety of dishes that highlight indigenous ingredients and unique flavors. From chicken wrapped in banana leaves to Monpa style cheese, the pop-up offers a culinary journey through the hills, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of the region.
